name: Ryujong Credit Bank

attribution.legal_posture: OFAC-designated North Korea-based financial institution; Treasury reported sanctions-avoidance, foreign-currency remittance, money-laundering and overseas-worker transaction support. Administrative sanctions designation; the record has no criminal charge or conviction.

caveats: Administrative sanctions are an administrative finding; the record carries no criminal charge or conviction.

sources.support: Treasury identifies Ryujong Credit Bank as a North Korea-based financial institution that provided financial assistance for sanctions avoidance between China and North Korea, including foreign-currency remittance, money laundering, and transactions for overseas North Korean workers. This is an administrative sanctions finding, not a criminal conviction.
